prose.favour: The case in its favour rests mostly on the recent price trend: the share price is 5.6% higher than a year ago. Also in its favour: over the past year the share did 7.8 percentage points better than the Nifty 50; the share price is close to its 52-week high; and profit grew 152% compared with a year earlier. Other areas on this side: growth, the balance sheet, what the price asks for the earnings.
prose.against: The case against rests mostly on price behaviour: the 3-year maximum drawdown was -70.6%, a deep fall. Also against it: one-year volatility is 48.3%, high; growth scores only 0 of 100 against the comparison pool; and quality scores only 13 of 100 against the comparison pool. Other areas on this side: growth, the quality of the business, the recent price trend.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 8 points in favour and 8 against give an even split. The pool score is 33 of 100. The side that carries most weight is the recent price trend. That gives an educational rating of Underweight with high confidence. This is a rule-based reading of the evidence above, not a prediction.
